# CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:reference` from the command schema. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Global Options

| Flag | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | boolean | Print the result as JSON, even on a terminal. |

## Envelope

With `--json`, or whenever stdout is piped, stdout carries exactly one JSON value. A success is `{"data": ...}`. A failure is `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": ...}}`, where `details` is omitted when empty. Each command below shows its `data`. On a terminal without `--json`, a command prints a table or text, and a failure prints `jm: <message>` to stderr. `--help` and `--version` always print plain text.

## Exit Codes

| Exit | Code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 |  | Success |
| 2 | `validation_failed` | A flag, argument or value is missing, unknown or invalid, or Jira rejected the input. |
| 3 | `not_found` | The issue, comment, worklog, link, attachment, sprint, view or timer does not exist. |
| 4 | `permission_denied` | Jira refused the credentials, or no one is logged in. |
| 5 | `jira_error` | Jira failed or sent a response the CLI cannot read, after the CLI retried. |
| 1 | `internal` | A bug in jm. |
| 130 |  | Interrupted with Ctrl-C |

Every error code, with its fix, is in [errors.md](errors.md).

## auth

### jm auth login

```
jm auth login [--site <url>] [--project <key>] [--email <text>] [--token-stdin]
```

Verifies the credentials against Jira, saves the site, project and email to the settings file and the token to the Keychain. On a terminal it prompts for a missing site, project, email or token. The token never travels in a flag.

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--site <url>` | text | no |  | The Jira site URL. Defaults to the settings file. |
| `--project <key>` | text | no |  | The Jira project key. Defaults to the settings file. |
| `--email <text>` | text | no |  | The account email. Defaults to the settings file. |
| `--token-stdin` | boolean | no |  | Read the API token from stdin. |

#### Examples

```sh
# Log in, prompting for what is missing.
jm auth login
```

```sh
# Log in without prompts, reading the token from stdin.
jm auth login --site https://example.atlassian.net --project PSAPAC --email me@example.com --token-stdin
```

#### Output

The account that is now logged in.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "siteUrl": "https://example.atlassian.net",
    "projectKey": "PSAPAC",
    "email": "me@example.com",
    "accountId": "5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5",
    "displayName": "Shane Dolley"
  }
}
```

#### Exits

| Exit | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `validation_failed` | A value is missing and there is no terminal to prompt on. |
| 4 | `permission_denied` | Jira refuses the token. |

#### Effects

Writes: state, keychain.

Calls:

- `@jira-mgr/core/auth#login`

## issue

### jm issue list

```
jm issue list [--view <id-or-name>] [--search <text>] [--assignee <assignee>] [--status <name-or-id>] [--label <text>] [--type <name-or-id>] [--sprint <sprint>] [--mine] [--show-done] [--limit <integer>]
```

Lists the project's issues, hiding Done ones unless `--show-done`. A view's filters apply first, and each filter flag replaces that field's list.

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--view <id-or-name>` | text | no |  | Start from a saved view, by id or by name in any case. |
| `--search <text>` | text | no |  | Match this text in the summary or key. |
| `--assignee <assignee>` | text | no |  | Keep issues assigned to `me`, `unassigned` or an account id. Repeatable. |
| `--status <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | Keep issues in this status. Repeatable. |
| `--label <text>` | text | no |  | Keep issues with this label. Repeatable. |
| `--type <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | Keep issues of this type. Repeatable. |
| `--sprint <sprint>` | text | no |  | Keep issues in this sprint: an id, a name or `current`. Repeatable. |
| `--mine` | boolean | no |  | Keep only issues assigned to you. |
| `--show-done` | boolean | no |  | Include Done issues. |
| `--limit <integer>` | integer | no |  | Stop after this many matching issues. |

#### Examples

```sh
# List your open issues.
jm issue list --mine
```

```sh
# List up to 20 in-progress issues labelled etl.
jm issue list --status "In Progress" --label etl --limit 20
```

#### Output

An array of issues.

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "10042",
      "key": "PSAPAC-12",
      "summary": "Build the loader",
      "issueType": {
        "id": "10001",
        "name": "Story",
        "subtask": false,
        "hierarchyLevel": 0
      },
      "status": {
        "id": "3",

      },
      "resolution": null,
      "parentKey": "PSAPAC-10",

        "etl"
      ],
      "priority": {
        "id": "3",
        "name": "Medium"
      },
      "customer": {
        "id": "10100",
        "value": "Acme Corp"
      },

        "id": "10200",
        "value": "Data migration"
      },

        {
          "id": 7,
```

#### Exits

|---|---|---|
| 3 | `not_found` | `--view` names no saved view. |
| 2 | `validation_failed` | A state file, such as the saved views, is invalid. |

#### Effects

### jm issue tree

```
jm issue tree [--view <id-or-name>] [--search <text>] [--assignee <assignee>] [--status <name-or-id>] [--label <text>] [--type <name-or-id>] [--sprint <sprint>] [--mine] [--show-done] [--show-empty-customers]
```

Groups the same issues as `issue list` by Customer, then Epic, with Subtasks under their parents. Done children collapse into a `+N done` chip.

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--view <id-or-name>` | text | no |  | Start from a saved view, by id or by name in any case. |
| `--search <text>` | text | no |  | Match this text in the summary or key. |
| `--assignee <assignee>` | text | no |  | Keep issues assigned to `me`, `unassigned` or an account id. Repeatable. |
| `--status <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | Keep issues in this status. Repeatable. |
| `--label <text>` | text | no |  | Keep issues with this label. Repeatable. |
| `--type <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | Keep issues of this type. Repeatable. |
| `--sprint <sprint>` | text | no |  | Keep issues in this sprint: an id, a name or `current`. Repeatable. |
| `--mine` | boolean | no |  | Keep only issues assigned to you. |
| `--show-done` | boolean | no |  | Include Done issues. |
| `--show-empty-customers` | boolean | no |  | Include Customers with no matching issue. |

#### Examples

```sh
# Show your open issues as a tree.
jm issue tree --mine
```

#### Output

An array of Customer groups, each with its Epics and the issues under no Epic.

### jm issue create

```
jm issue create [--type <type>] --summary <text> --customer <name-or-id> --engagement <name-or-id> [--parent <key>] [--description <markdown>] [--description-file <file>] [--adf <file>] [--assignee <assignee>] [--priority <name-or-id>] [--label <text>] [--start <date>] [--due <date>] [--estimate <duration>] [--time-remaining <number>]
```

Creates an issue. Customer and Engagement are required; name them in any case or by option id. Give at most one of the three description inputs.

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type <type>` | enum | no | `Story` | The issue type. One of Epic, Story, Task, Bug, Subtask. |
| `--summary <text>` | text | yes |  | The summary line. |
| `--customer <name-or-id>` | text | yes |  | The Customer. |
| `--engagement <name-or-id>` | text | yes |  | The Engagement. |
| `--parent <key>` | issue-key | no |  | The parent issue. |
| `--description <markdown>` | markdown | no |  | Description as Markdown. Conflicts with `--description-file`, `--adf`. |
| `--description-file <file>` | file | no |  | Read the description as Markdown from a file, or `-` for stdin. Conflicts with `--description`, `--adf`. |
| `--adf <file>` | file | no |  | Read the description as an Atlassian Document Format file, or `-` for stdin. Conflicts with `--description`, `--description-file`. |
| `--assignee <assignee>` | text | no |  | Assign to `me`, an account id or a name that matches one user. |
| `--priority <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | The priority. |
| `--label <text>` | text | no |  | A label. Repeat the flag for more. Repeatable. |
| `--start <date>` | date | no |  | The start date, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `--due <date>` | date | no |  | The due date, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `--estimate <duration>` | duration | no |  | The original estimate, such as `1d 4h`. |
| `--time-remaining <number>` | number | no |  | The Time remaining field value. |

#### Examples

```sh
# Create a Story under an Epic.
jm issue create --summary "Build the loader" --customer "Acme Corp" --engagement "Data migration" --parent PSAPAC-10
```

```sh
# Create a Bug with a Markdown description from a file.
jm issue create --type Bug --summary "Loader drops rows" --customer "Acme Corp" --engagement "Data migration" --description-file bug.md
```

#### Output

The new issue.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "key": "PSAPAC-14",
    "id": "10050",
    "url": "https://example.atlassian.net/browse/PSAPAC-14"
  }
}
```

#### Exits

| Exit | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `validation_failed` | A name is unknown or ambiguous, two description inputs are given, a Subtask has no `--parent`, or `--parent` is outside the project in settings. |
| 4 | `permission_denied` | No project is set in settings. |

#### Effects

Writes: jira.

Calls:

- `@jira-mgr/core/write#createIssue`
- `@jira-mgr/core/lookups#getFieldOptions`
- `@jira-mgr/core/lookups#searchAssignableUsers`
- `@jira-mgr/core/adf#markdownToAdf`

### jm issue edit

```
jm issue edit <key> [--summary <text>] [--description <markdown>] [--description-file <file>] [--adf <file>] [--clear-description] [--assignee <assignee>] [--start <date>] [--due <date>] [--time-remaining <number>] [--priority <name-or-id>] [--label <text>] [--add-label <text>] [--remove-label <text>] [--parent <key>] [--customer <name-or-id>] [--engagement <name-or-id>] [--estimate <duration>] [--type <type>]
```

Changes only the fields you pass. A flag marked clearable takes `none` to empty the field. `--label` replaces the labels and conflicts with `--add-label` and `--remove-label`.

#### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | issue-key | yes | The issue key. |

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--summary <text>` | text | no |  | The summary line. |
| `--description <markdown>` | markdown | no |  | Description as Markdown. Conflicts with `--description-file`, `--adf`. |
| `--description-file <file>` | file | no |  | Read the description as Markdown from a file, or `-` for stdin. Conflicts with `--description`, `--adf`. |
| `--adf <file>` | file | no |  | Read the description as an Atlassian Document Format file, or `-` for stdin. Conflicts with `--description`, `--description-file`. |
| `--clear-description` | boolean | no |  | Empty the description. Conflicts with `--description`, `--description-file`, `--adf`. |
| `--assignee <assignee>` | text | no |  | Assign to `me`, an account id or a name that matches one user. Pass `none` to clear it. `none` clears it. |
| `--start <date>` | date | no |  | The start date. Pass `none` to clear it. `none` clears it. |
| `--due <date>` | date | no |  | The due date. Pass `none` to clear it. `none` clears it. |
| `--time-remaining <number>` | number | no |  | The Time remaining field value. Pass `none` to clear it. `none` clears it. |
| `--priority <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | The priority. |
| `--label <text>` | text | no |  | Replace the labels with these. Repeatable. Conflicts with `--add-label`, `--remove-label`. |
| `--add-label <text>` | text | no |  | Add a label. Repeatable. Conflicts with `--label`. |
| `--remove-label <text>` | text | no |  | Remove a label. Repeatable. Conflicts with `--label`. |
| `--parent <key>` | issue-key | no |  | The parent issue. The Customer and Engagement are not copied from the new parent; pass `--customer` and `--engagement` to change them. |
| `--customer <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | The Customer. |
| `--engagement <name-or-id>` | text | no |  | The Engagement. |
| `--estimate <duration>` | duration | no |  | The original estimate, such as `1d 4h`. |
| `--type <type>` | enum | no |  | Change the issue type. Only a Story, Task or Bug can change, and only to one of the three. One of Story, Task, Bug. |

#### Examples

```sh
# Assign to yourself and set a due date.
jm issue edit PSAPAC-12 --assignee me --due 2026-10-14
```

```sh
# Unassign and add a label.
jm issue edit PSAPAC-12 --assignee none --add-label etl
```

#### Output

The issue key and the names of the options sent, each once.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "key": "PSAPAC-12",
    "changed": [
      "assignee",
      "due"
    ]
  }
}
```

#### Exits

| Exit | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `validation_failed` | Nothing is given to change, a name is unknown or ambiguous, `--type` is given for an issue that is not a Story, Task or Bug, or the key or `--parent` is outside the project in settings. |
| 4 | `permission_denied` | No project is set in settings. |
| 3 | `not_found` | The issue does not exist. |

#### Effects

Writes: jira.

Calls:

- `@jira-mgr/core/search#getIssue`
- `@jira-mgr/core/write#editIssue`
- `@jira-mgr/core/lookups#getFieldOptions`
- `@jira-mgr/core/lookups#searchAssignableUsers`
- `@jira-mgr/core/adf#markdownToAdf`

### jm issue delete

```
jm issue delete <key> [--confirm] [--with-subtasks]
```

Deletes the issue for good. `--confirm` is required. An issue with subtasks needs `--with-subtasks`, which deletes them too.

#### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | issue-key | yes | The issue key. |

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | boolean | no |  | Confirm the permanent delete. |
| `--with-subtasks` | boolean | no |  | Delete the issue's subtasks too. |

#### Examples

```sh
# Delete an issue with no subtasks.
jm issue delete PSAPAC-12 --confirm
```

```sh
# Delete an issue and its subtasks.
jm issue delete PSAPAC-12 --confirm --with-subtasks
```

#### Output

The deleted key and the subtasks deleted with it.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "key": "PSAPAC-12",
    "deletedSubtasks": [
      "PSAPAC-13"
    ]
  }
}
```

#### Exits

| Exit | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `validation_failed` | `--confirm` is missing, the issue has subtasks and `--with-subtasks` is missing, or the key is outside the project in settings. |
| 4 | `permission_denied` | No project is set in settings. |
| 3 | `not_found` | The issue does not exist. |

#### Effects

Writes: jira.

Calls:

- `@jira-mgr/core/search#getIssue`
- `@jira-mgr/core/write#deleteIssue`

## status

### jm status set

```
jm status set <key> <status>
```

Move an issue to a status

#### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | issue-key | yes | The issue key. |
| `status` | text | yes | The status name in any case, or its id. |

#### Examples

```sh
# Start work on an issue.
jm status set PSAPAC-12 "In Progress"
```

#### Output

The issue, its status and whether a transition ran.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "key": "PSAPAC-12",
    "status": "In Progress",
    "changed": true
  }
}
```

#### Exits

| Exit | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `validation_failed` | The status is unreachable from the current one (the message lists the available statuses), or the key is outside the project in settings. |
| 4 | `permission_denied` | No project is set in settings. |
| 3 | `not_found` | The issue does not exist. |

#### Effects

Writes: jira.

Calls:

- `@jira-mgr/core/search#getIssue`
- `@jira-mgr/core/write#transitionIssue`

- `@jira-mgr/core/extras#listLinkTypes`

## sprint

### jm sprint list

```
jm sprint list [--all]
```

Lists the active sprint and the dated future sprints. `--all` adds closed and undated ones.

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | boolean | no |  | Include closed and undated sprints. |

#### Examples

```sh
# List the active and upcoming sprints.
jm sprint list
```

#### Output

An array of sprints.

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 7,
      "name": "Sprint 7",
      "state": "active",
      "startDate": "2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "endDate": "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Exits

| Exit | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | `not_found` | The project has no board that supports sprints. |

#### Effects

Writes: nothing.

Calls:

- `@jira-mgr/core/sprints#findBoard`
- `@jira-mgr/core/sprints#listSprints`

## help

### jm help

```
jm help [command...]
```

Prints help for a command. With `--json`, or when piped, it prints the help document: every command with its flags, examples, output and exit codes. Name a command to print only that command.

#### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command...` | text | no | A command path, such as `issue delete`. |

#### Examples

```sh
# Print every command as JSON.
jm help --json
```

```sh
# Print one command as JSON.
jm help issue delete --json
```

#### Output

The help document, or one command object when a command is named.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "name": "jm",
    "version": "0.0.0",
    "globalOptions": [],
    "exitCodes": [],
    "commands": []
  }
}
```

#### Exits

| Exit | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `validation_failed` | The named command does not exist. |

#### Effects

Writes: nothing.

Calls: none.
